Meet the Founder

Sanjana Muthreja

Dancer•Educator•Artist

Sanjana Muthreja is an internationally acclaimed belly dancer, educator, and artist with over 18 years of experience. A pioneer in Egyptian and Fusion Belly Dance, Sanjana has redefined the art form in India through her institution, Art of Bellydance with Sanjana.

Driven by her passion for empowering dancers, Sanjana created and curated an in-depth belly dance course that caters to aspiring dancers at all levels. Her structured program spans multiple levels, combining technique, artistry, and personal expression. Through her teacher training program, she has helped countless students fulfill their dream of mastering belly dance while equipping them to become professional instructors themselves.

Renowned for her expertise in “Drum Solo” and “Bollywood Belly,” Sanjana was trained by the legendary Sadie Marquardt, the queen of Drum Solo. She also incorporates elements of Kathak and Yoga into her teaching, offering a holistic approach that blends tradition with innovation.

Sanjana’s vision goes beyond performance; she sees belly dance as a transformative art form that fosters self-confidence, creativity, and community. Her institution stands as a testament to her mission of nurturing talent and making belly dance accessible, engaging, and empowering for all.

With her trailblazing approach and dedication, Sanjana continues to inspire a new generation of dancers while elevating the global recognition of belly dance as an art form.
